description: MIRA Evidence — a specific empirical observation from one application of a research method. Maps mira.yaml class Evidence (is_a Entity; mixins Argument, NodeSchema). DRAFT.

main.description: An evidence node. The four-layer chain is realized by observationStatement (the claim it speaks to), observationBase (the literal data), observationOriginActivity / isGroundedIn (the study that produced it) and sourceDocument (the paper). observationStatement and observationBase are required, mirroring the cardinality-1 restriction in the schema.

description.description: MIRA dgb:description, inline form — what was observed.

attributedTo.description: MIRA creator, only when it differs from the signing repo DID.

observationStatement.description: MIRA observationStatement — the Claim this observation speaks to.

observationBase.description: MIRA observationBase — the actual data the observation rests on (figure, blot, dataset).

observationOriginActivity.description: MIRA observationOriginActivity — the Study/Activity that produced the data.

isGroundedIn.description: MIRA is_grounded_in — the Study grounding this evidence (inverse 'grounds' is AppView-derived).

sourceDocument.description: MIRA sourceDocument — the SourceDocument reporting this evidence.

supports.description: MIRA supports — Claims this evidence supports (Evidence is an Argument).

opposes.description: MIRA opposes — Claims this evidence opposes.
